PullRequest.Title: Enrich telemetry for model config tracking and improve model picker

Scenarios.Scenario: Open and close the flat or tabbed model picker
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Opening synchronously creates one telemetry session, builds picker items, and renders the list. The tabbed picker may also compute heights for the regular Copilot list and one alternate Auto/routing list before first layout; height computation only loops over item metadata. Closing the UI is synchronous and does not wait for pending configuration saves; only the close telemetry event is deferred.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Dispatch model-picker opened and closed telemetry through the telemetry service appenders
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Two events per completed picker session, plus one event per explicit interaction such as model/configuration/pin change
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: There were no picker open/close events; model-change telemetry already dispatched once per selection.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The open event is synchronously handed to configured appenders during open; close dispatch is immediate unless configuration writes are pending, in which case only telemetry waits.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: The regular sizing pass scales with the number of Copilot rows as before. The new alternate sizing pass contains the bounded first-party routing choices (Auto tiers and HydraFusion) when an explicit fallback model exists, so it does not duplicate the full provider catalogue.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: UI construction and measurement run serially on the UI thread. A warm picker retains its measured sizing; refreshes recompute serially. No subprocess, IPC, database, or network fan-out is introduced.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Tabbed picker creation is lazy. Its measured sizing is retained after the first sizing pass, while model-card caches are cleared on hide. Flat picker items and hover disposables remain scoped to one open.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the changed build callback, arithmetic-only computeHeightForItems implementation, telemetry constructor, and hide callbacks were traced directly.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact model catalogue size and telemetry appender cost vary, but the introduced alternate list and event cardinality are bounded.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The extra first-layout CPU/allocation is bounded and the telemetry volume is one open/close pair per user session.

Scenarios.Scenario: Search or filter models in the picker
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Typing follows the existing list filtering path; opening tabbed search rebuilds the picker once, and subsequent input filters the list. The new callbacks only set an in-memory boolean on the telemetry session.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Existing filtering and cross-provider search scale with the effective model count. The diff adds O(1) state mutation per typed input event and no per-model boundary operation.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: All work is synchronous on the UI thread with no added queue, parallelism, IPC, filesystem, database, subprocess, or network operation.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Search remains transient and resets when the popup hides. No new cache or retained query data is introduced; query text is not stored in telemetry.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: both onType and onDidChangeFilter lead only to logSearch(), which assigns a boolean.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Large third-party model catalogues can make the pre-existing search rebuild expensive, but the changed telemetry callback does not amplify that collection work.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression; the diff adds constant work to an existing input path.

Scenarios.CriticalPath: Selection applies the model and closes the picker as before, with enriched model-change telemetry and a new close event. Pinning still persists the pinned list and rebuilds/reopens the flat picker; the diff additionally logs one pin-change event and reuses the same telemetry session.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Persist the pinned model ID list through the profile storage service
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One existing storage write per real pin or unpin change
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same _savePinnedModels storage write occurred per real pin/unpin change.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Occurs synchronously in the existing pin/unpin action path before listeners fire.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Dispatch model-change, pin-change, and picker-close telemetry
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One model-change event per selection, one pin-change event per effective pin state transition, and one close event per picker session
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Model selection already emitted one telemetry event; pin changes and picker close did not emit their new events.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Telemetry is synchronously handed to appenders but does not add a waited network request. Pin telemetry follows the existing storage write.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Cost scales with explicit user interactions, not with all models. Model classification scans the locally held vendor descriptors once per logged event.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Interactions are serialized by the UI. Flat-picker pinning closes and immediately rebuilds one picker; no concurrent fan-out is added.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The model cache and pinned ID storage behavior are unchanged. Reopened flat pickers reuse the same telemetry session only for the pinning interaction.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: pin/unpin implementations and all callers were inspected, including the pre-existing persistence call.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Telemetry appender implementation differs by product build, but event cardinality is strictly tied to user actions.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression; added telemetry is bounded to one event per effective action.

Scenarios.Scenario: Change model configuration and dismiss or reopen the picker
Scenarios.CriticalPath: A choice reads current local configuration, queues one save per model key, and writes the existing scoped/global configuration. The picker can dismiss immediately. The diff snapshots pending promises at close so only the close telemetry event waits until existing saves and their change events settle.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Persist editor-scoped configuration through storage and save the profile languageModels configuration file
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One existing scoped storage update and at most one serialized profile configuration-file save per effective user configuration change
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Configuration changes already awaited the same setModelConfiguration persistence path.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The action awaits the save for post-save UI/configuration reporting, but picker dismissal itself does not await it. This boundary predates the diff.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Dispatch configuration-change telemetry after save and close telemetry after all pending per-scope saves settle
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One configuration event per effective changed property and one close event per picker session
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Configuration-change telemetry was already emitted after each successful save, without correlated close telemetry or save-order waiting.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Ordering is enforced only for telemetry; Promise.allSettled is not awaited by the UI close path.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Writes scale with deliberate configuration selections. SequencerByKey coalesces ordering per model identifier but does not coalesce distinct choices; pending keys are removed when their promise settles. A close snapshots only currently pending model keys.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Configuration saves are serialized per model identifier; different model identifiers may proceed independently. Close telemetry joins the current pending promises without starting duplicate filesystem operations.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Configuration values are cached in the per-editor store and model service. The WeakMap is keyed by configuration scope, and SequencerByKey removes settled keys; there is no persistent accumulation from completed edits.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: setModelConfigValues, SequencerByKey cleanup, the configuration store, language-model configuration file save, and close callbacks were traced.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Filesystem save duration varies, but it is pre-existing and off the picker-close critical path in the new coordination logic.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The diff neither adds configuration writes nor blocks dismissal, and pending telemetry retention is bounded by outstanding user edits and released when their existing saves settle.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance review across all 20 changed files. Checked UI-thread sizing/filter work, telemetry serialization and dispatch, pin persistence, configuration filesystem saves, per-key sequencing, promise cleanup, and picker disposal. No high-confidence actionable performance regression was introduced, and the PR does not provide sufficient evidence of fixing a shipped performance regression.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
